verses.ar: تَرْنِيمَةُ ٱلْمَصَاعِدِ عِنْدَمَا رَدَّ ٱلرَّبُّ سَبْيَ صِهْيَوْنَ، صِرْنَا مِثْلَ ٱلْحَالِمِينَ.
verses.kjv: A Song of degrees. When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
verses.web: A Song of Ascents. When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ ٱمْتَلَأَتْ أَفْوَاهُنَا ضِحْكًا، وَأَلْسِنَتُنَا تَرَنُّمًا. حِينَئِذٍ قَالُوا بَيْنَ ٱلْأُمَمِ: «إِنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ قَدْ عَظَّمَ ٱلْعَمَلَ مَعَ هَؤُلَاءِ».
verses.kjv: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.
verses.web: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “Yahweh has done great things for them.”

verses.ar: عَظَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ ٱلْعَمَلَ مَعَنَا، وَصِرْنَا فَرِحِينَ.
verses.kjv: The LORD hath done great things for us; [whereof] we are glad.
verses.web: Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.

verses.ar: ٱرْدُدْ يَارَبُّ سَبْيَنَا، مِثْلَ ٱلسَّوَاقِي فِي ٱلْجَنُوبِ.
verses.kjv: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.
verses.web: Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, like the streams in the Negev.

verses.kjv: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.web: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

verses.ar: ٱلذَّاهِبُ ذَهَابًا بِٱلْبُكَاءِ حَامِلًا مِبْذَرَ ٱلزَّرْعِ، مَجِيئًا يَجِيءُ بِٱلتَّرَنُّمِ حَامِلًا حُزَمَهُ.
verses.kjv: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves [with him].
verses.web: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
